question: What preparatory fixation must be performed before carrying out ritual entry in proper sequence?
premises: A fiery fixation can be performed.
Ritual entry is to be carried out.
The fixation precedes the entry in proper order.
inference: After performing the fiery fixation, one should carry out ritual entry in due order.
plain_english: Having performed the fiery fixation, one should then carry out the act of entry in proper sequence.
